【B1 影响面分析 · 只读，不改代码】flowId=wuxia-roguelike，workflowId=wf-739312023202ee992b7c8955，stage=B1。客户实测：打开 index.html 点「踏入江湖」后每帧控制台 `Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'pressed')`，游戏无法进行（移动/攻击/波次/升级/重开全停）。

幕僚只读初判（需你核实，不代替你的结论）：game/app/app.js 的 pollFrameInput() 里 `var pressed = engine.input.wasPressed;` 之后独立调用 `pressed('escape')`；game/engine/input.js 的 wasPressed 访问 `this.pressed`，IIFE 为严格模式，独立调用时 this=undefined ⇒ 每帧抛错，与客户现象一致。

请做**只读影响面分析**（禁止改任何文件、禁止提交）：
1) 核对 game/app/app.js 全部输入相关调用（pollFrameInput、setInputEnabled、player.update 传参、ctx.input 等）并对照 game/engine/input.js 的 this 依赖，确认根因、触发路径与每帧位置（哪些状态仍会走到、异常后 renderFrame/updateUi/endFrame 是否被跳过、下一帧为何继续抛）。
2) 排查同类风险：game/app/ 其他文件与 game/app/ 之外被传入输入对象/方法的调用点（例如 `ctx.on: bus.on` 的解引用、`engine.endFrame()` 内部 `input.endFrame()`、UI/player 对 `input.*` 的使用方式），区分「真实缺陷」与「安全的方法调用」；给出受影响文件与最小修复建议（如 `engine.input.wasPressed('escape')`、或 bind(this)、或改为 ctx.on 包装），并评估 `input.endFrame()` 是否同样存在解引用问题。
3) 评估副作用/回归风险与验证要点：升级面板键盘（1/2/3、方向键+Enter）、暂停（Esc/P）、失焦自动暂停、结算重开（R/Enter）、无 UI 兜底路径。
4) 交付：**不要写任何文件**（你的写区只有 game/app/，B1 为只读阶段）；通过 submit_report 交回：summary 写根因、触发路径、受影响文件清单、最小修复建议、副作用与回归风险、验证要点；evidence[] 每项为纯项目相对文件路径（如 game/app/app.js、game/engine/input.js），不要写描述句。正式影响面报告由运营落盘到 docs/scheduling/。

硬约束：本阶段只分析不改实现（B2 定范围后另派 B3 修复）；不运行 shell/node/npm、不做环境探测、不计算 hash；不写 docs/、不改 game/**；不提交 git。
完成后请交回报告（改了什么/结论/证据）。

Now root cause analysis of app.js pollFrameInput:

```js
function pollFrameInput() {
  if (!engine || !engine.input || typeof engine.input.wasPressed !== 'function') { return; }
  var pressed = engine.input.wasPressed;
  if (state === STATES.PLAYING || state === STATES.PAUSED) {
    if (pressed('escape') || pressed('p')) { togglePause(); }
    return;
  }
  ...
  pressed('enter') || pressed(' ')
  ...
}
```

`wasPressed` is on prototype; body uses `this.pressed`, normalizeName (no this). Calling `pressed('escape')` → this=undefined in strict mode → TypeError "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'pressed')". Exactly matches customer message.

Trigger path: frame() calls pollFrameInput() every frame regardless of state (after camera update). So in ANY state the error throws — even MENU, because after PLAYING/PAUSED branch, it falls through to `if (!ui && state === MENU && (pressed('enter')...))`. Wait: in MENU, `!ui` false if UI exists, and `state === MENU` true; expression `!ui && state === MENU && (pressed('enter') || pressed(' '))` — short-circuit: `!ui` is false → the whole && chain short-circuits, so pressed not called. Then `if (!hasResultUi && (state GAME_OVER||VICTORY) ...)` — state not in those, false; but `!hasResultUi` evaluated first: hasResultUi = ui && typeof showResult === function → true if UI loaded; `!hasResultUi` false → short-circuit again, pressed not called.

But wait: Menu with UI present: after clicking 踏入江湖 → state becomes PLAYING (startGame → resetRun → state=PLAYING). Then next frame pollFrameInput: state PLAYING → `pressed('escape')` → throws. Yes: first branch always evaluates pressed('escape') when state PLAYING/PAUSED. So as soon as game starts, throw each frame at pollFrameInput.

Actually even before: in PLAYING/PAUSED branch always throws. In MENU with UI: no throw (short-circuit). Without UI in MENU: pressed('enter') → throws too. In MENU, the customer says after clicking start → error. Consistent.

- accumulator not advanced, stepWorld never runs (no movement/attacks/waves/exp/level)
